name: Cute CTA Button
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Cute CTA Button is a powerful WordPress Gutenberg block plugin that allows you to create stunning, professional-looking buttons in seconds. Whether you’re building a landing page, promoting affiliate products, or adding call-to-action buttons, Cute CTA Button has you covered.

Key Features

  • 10 Beautiful Preset Designs – Choose from professionally designed button styles
  • Full Color Customization – Override any preset with custom colors for background, text, and hover states
  • Button Positioning – Align buttons left, center, or right
  • Hover Effects – Smooth animations and transitions on hover
  • SEO-Friendly – Built-in nofollow and target=”_blank” options
  • Responsive Design – Looks great on all devices
  • Rich Text Support – Add bold and italic formatting to button text
  • No Coding Required – Easy-to-use visual interface
  • Lightweight – Clean code with minimal footprint

Available Button Designs

  1. Classic Gradient – Beautiful gradient with hover effects
  2. Soft Material – Modern material design with subtle shadows
  3. Neon Glow – Futuristic neon style with glow effects
  4. 3D Raised – Three-dimensional button with press animation
  5. Elegant Outline – Minimalist outline design with smooth hover transition
  6. Glass Morphism – Modern glass effect with blur and transparency
  7. Vibrant Gradient – Bright gradient with smooth color transition
  8. Minimal Shadow – Clean white button with subtle shadows
  9. Gradient Border – Colorful animated gradient border effect
  10. Animated Pulse – Pulsing glow animation that stops on hover

Perfect For

  • Affiliate marketers
  • Landing pages
  • Call-to-action buttons
  • Download buttons
  • Product promotions
  • Newsletter signups
  • E-commerce sites
  • Blog posts
  • Service pages

Easy to Use

  1. Add the “Cute CTA Button” block in the Gutenberg editor
  2. Enter your button text
  3. Choose a design from 10 presets
  4. Customize colors (optional)
  5. Add your link URL
  6. Select positioning and link options
  7. Publish!

Developer Friendly

  • Clean, well-documented code
  • Follows WordPress coding standards
  • Properly escaped, validated, and sanitized
  • Translation ready
  • Server-side rendering for better performance
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Cute CTA Button”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Getting Started

  1. Create a new post or page, or edit an existing one
  2. Click the (+) button to add a new block
  3. Search for “Cute CTA Button” and add it
  4. Configure your button settings in the sidebar
  5. Publish your page
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with the Classic Editor?

No, Cute CTA Button is designed specifically for the Gutenberg block editor. You need WordPress 5.0 or higher with Gutenberg enabled.

Can I use custom colors?

Yes! You can customize the background color, text color, and hover color. Custom colors automatically override the preset designs.

Can I add multiple buttons on one page?

Absolutely! Add as many Cute CTA Button blocks as you need. Each button can have different designs and settings.

Does it work with page builders?

Cute CTA Button is a Gutenberg block. It works natively in the WordPress block editor. Compatibility with third-party page builders is not guaranteed.

Are the buttons mobile-responsive?

Yes! All button designs are fully responsive and look great on all screen sizes.

Can I use bold or italic text in buttons?

Yes! The button text field supports basic formatting including bold and italic text.

What about SEO?

The plugin includes options for nofollow and target=”_blank” attributes, which are enabled by default for affiliate and external links.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes! Cute CTA Button is fully translation-ready with all strings properly internationalized.

Does it slow down my website?

No! The plugin uses inline CSS and JavaScript, is properly enqueued, and follows WordPress best practices for optimal performance.

Can I request a new button design?

Absolutely! Feel free to suggest new designs through the support forum.
